summary: Backend-only testing for Moodful mental-wellness app. Created /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 27 tests) covering auth (register/login/me), entries (private/public create, list, calendar filter, community feed, react toggle, 404 on missing), tasks CRUD (create, list-by-date, patch toggle, delete, 404), and auth guards on all protected endpoints. All 27 tests passed against the public URL. Verified MongoDB _id never leaks into responses. No backend issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /auth/me without any Authorization header returns 403 (FastAPI HTTPBearer default) instead of 401. Tests accept 401 or 403, but if strict 401 required, set HTTPBearer(auto_error=False) and raise 401 manually.
server.py TaskUpdate.dict() uses deprecated Pydantic v1 API — should use model_dump(exclude_unset=True) for Pydantic v2 forward-compat.
server.py: exclude_unset filter combined with `v is not None` means clients cannot clear a title to empty string; acceptable for this app but worth noting.
server.py: JWT_SECRET falls back to a hardcoded default when env var is missing — safe for preview, but production should require it.
seed_data_creation: No permanent seed data. Tests create ephemeral TEST_* users and TEST_ entries/tasks; created entries are deleted at the end of the session (tasks are deleted within their own test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. Re-run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Fresh users are registered per session so tests are idempotent. When adding new endpoints, extend backend_test.py with a new Test class following the same fixture pattern (user_a session-scoped, auth_headers helper, _no_mongo_id assertion).
